description: Check whether Fold serves a given ZIP code. Returns service availability, the market name (LA/SF), and a list of pickup window options that can be passed to book_residential_pickup. book_residential_pickup only accepts ZIPs this tool reports as served.

zipCode.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, e.g. "90210" or "94103". ZIP+4 and full addresses are accepted; the 5-digit ZIP is extracted.

name: check_service_zip
title: Check ZIP coverage
